premise: In an early-1990s local TV station being squeezed by cable, consolidation, and the first rumblings of the internet, late-night horror host Madame Massacre fights to stay relevant while a media conglomerate’s takeover reveals a literal demonic agenda. As the station’s on-air camp and off-air reality blur in a world where the macabre is treated as merely eccentric, Maddie must use her wit, sex appeal, and horror-host savvy to outplay infernal corporate power.
tone: Satirical, bawdy, adult, and campy; sharp workplace/media satire with occult horror used primarily as a vehicle for comedy.
setting: A local television station in the early 1990s, during a period of industry upheaval from cable expansion, early internet culture, and media consolidation. The story world treats gothic and supernatural oddities with an Addams Family-like casualness rather than awe.
protagonist: Madame Massacre ("Maddie"), the player character: a sexy late-night horror host in the tradition of Vampira, Elvira, and Lily Munster. She is the same persona on-screen and off-screen—confident, seductive, and razor-witted, but privately anxious that she is becoming obsolete as both a performer and cultural figure.
core_hook: A predatory media conglomerate moves to absorb Maddie’s struggling station, led by a polished executive who is quite literally a demon from hell. To save her station, her show, and her own sense of relevance, Madame Massacre must navigate corporate corruption, occult peril, and the ridiculous dysfunction of local television.
must_have_elements: Madame Massacre as the direct player-character POV
An early-1990s local TV station under pressure from cable, the nascent internet, and media consolidation
Campy occult horror with real supernatural peril, but treated with casual normalcy within the world
A demonic corporate suit/executive spearheading the station takeover
The station news team’s sports anchor as a major character: a grown-up high-school-jock type
An open-secret, on-and-off sexual relationship between Maddie and the sports anchor
Adult Swim-style bawdy adult humor and satire
concept_summary: Set inside a shabby early-1990s local TV station, this horror-comedy follows Madame Massacre, a seductive late-night horror host who realizes she may be aging into obsolescence just as her employer faces corporate annihilation. The buyer is a hellish media conglomerate fronted by an actual demon in a suit, turning industry consolidation into both a satirical and supernatural threat. In a world where gothic weirdness is treated as normal background texture, Maddie must weaponize her charisma, wit, and horror-host theatrics to survive occult corporate warfare, station dysfunction, and her messy on-and-off affair with the station’s jockish sports anchor.
